raw:
The wearer moves down a hallway toward an exit. One woman is very close—roughly within arm’s reach—facing the wearer and smiling. Another person appears farther back near the doorway and is not directly blocking the wearer’s path. Since the nearby woman is oriented toward the wearer and reachable, a handshake and brief farewell is the most appropriate courteous conclusion; the farther person can also be verbally acknowledged.
